title: Gold fails to sustain a break above $4,200, US CPI in focus
summary: Gold (XAU/USD) edges lower on Monday, reversing earlier gains as traders avoid taking large positions ahead of US inflation data due later this week, which could offer fresh cues on the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) next move.

title: Gold sticks to modest losses, seems vulnerable below $4,200 on Fed hike bets, bullish USD
summary: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its intraday retracement slide from a one-week high, hitting a fresh daily low around $4,170 during the early European session on Monday.
